acceptance_criteria: the retirement screen lets a PLATFORM_ADMIN retire the oldest eligible month and displays the resulting retirement record

web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-partition-retention-drop.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts is authored against this real screen and passes

result.summary: FAIL on two MAJOR issues, independently verified against source: (1) SS1's async-design justification falsely claimed no index exists on event_type -- idx_events_type_p and idx_archive_type_p actually exist on the partitioned parents and propagate to every partition (priv/repo/migrations/20260922000001 line 114, ...000005 line 52). (2) The shared 'oldest eligible month' helper underlying both AC1 and AC2 had no function signature/name/module specified, left as an open fork (OQ5) rather than resolved. :TenantsManage precedent, AC coverage map, DB migration spec, and absence of implementation code all independently verified correct.
